typeDescriptions.chat: Model for text conversation and content generation

helpers.apiAddress: Select a common provider from the list, or enter any OpenAI API base address
helpers.modelName: If the list cannot be fetched, enter the model name manually
helpers.wireApi: default keeps automatic detection; chat / responses / gemini explicitly force the corresponding protocol
helpers.nameCopy: Set a new name for the copied LLM
helpers.nameChar: The group name cannot contain URL special characters (such as / ? & # = %), and cannot be changed after creation
helpers.fetchPrecondition: Please fill in the API address and key before fetching available models
helpers.connectionPrecondition: Please fill in the API address and model name before testing connectivity
helpers.useGlobalProxy: After enabling, all traffic uses the Default Proxy in system settings; when disabled, this LLM continues to use its own proxy address or direct connection
helpers.topK: Limits the number of candidate tokens; smaller values are more conservative
helpers.maxOutputTokens: Limits the total output token count, directly affecting duration and answer length
helpers.imageMaxCount: Blank means unlimited; 0 disables images; with a positive integer limit, built-in reference images are preserved first, and remaining images are degraded to text from old to new
helpers.cacheTransportProfile: default keeps the current automatic strategy; cache_control / prompt_cache_key / cache_prompt force the request field; off disables explicit cache fields
helpers.reasoningMode: Controls reasoning chain strength; default means no override, off disables the reasoning chain
helpers.textVerbosity: Controls the detail level of the final body text
helpers.replayReasoningContent: After enabling, the model-returned reasoning_content is carried back verbatim into later tool requests; enable only for reasoning-chain LLMs that clearly support this field
helpers.presencePenalty: Penalty for new content based on content already appearing in the generated text (-2 to 2)
helpers.frequencyPenalty: Penalty for new content based on the frequency of content appearing in the generated text (-2 to 2)
